label: Commercial landlord — tenant baseline
summary: Lease insurance clauses are negotiated, not standard, so this is a range rather than a rule: $1M each occurrence, $2M aggregate, landlord and property manager as additional insured, a mutual waiver, primary and non-contributory.

requirements.note: Required only where the tenant operates vehicles; tracked as advisory so it appears in the report without marking the tenant red.
Statutory workers' compensation where the tenant has employees.
Lease umbrella requirements range from nothing to $5,000,000; tracked as advisory until your own lease says otherwise.
The landlord, the property manager and any lender the lease names all have to appear. Certly checks that an accepted form is evidenced; who is scheduled on it is a reading only you can do.
Commercial leases usually make the waiver mutual. Certly checks the tenant's side.
